# js:// imports get bundled by esbuild into the inline <script>.
# The button click handler calls lib.add(2,3); after compilation the
# imported function body must be inlined and the handler must reference
# the bundled symbol.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Bundled function body from lib/index.ts is present in the output.
grep 'a \+ b' out/index.html

# esbuild rewrites the call to use a local binding (the IIFE's hoisted
# alias). The original SNGL alias name `__sngl_n_lib` may be inlined or
# renamed; either way, the addition operation surfaces.
grep 'function add' out/index.html

# IIFE wrapper from esbuild (`(() => { ... })()`).
grep '\(\(\) => \{' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import lib "js://./lib"

component main {
    var n = 0.0
    button(text="add", @click { n = lib.add(2.0, 3.0) })
    text(value=string(n))
}
-- lib/index.ts --
export function add(a: number, b: number): number {
    return a + b;
}
